How we care

Proper segregation = perfect wash.

Every load goes through the same four steps before it ever touches a machine.

  1. 1

    Weigh & sort by color

    Whites, light colors and darks each get their own tub. No bleeding, no surprise pink shirts.

  2. 2

    Separate by fabric type

    Drapes and heavy items are washed apart from standard garments so both come out right.

  3. 3

    Group by soiling level

    Blankets, towels, pants and jeans are grouped so heavy loads get the cycle they need.

  4. 4

    Never overloaded

    Balanced loads protect your clothes and our machines. That's how every wash stays quality.

Premium care: your laundry is never mixed.

Hindi ihahalo sa ibang laba. Your load is washed on its own, never with another customer's clothes.

Non-stop rain?

Laundry piling up? Let Mars-Clean handle it.

When the rain won't stop, the laundry gets left behind. Clothes dried indoors pick up that damp, musty amoy kulob smell. Prepare for the rainy season with five easy habits.

  1. Tip 1

    Wash blankets & comforters early

    Before the storms roll in.

  2. Tip 2

    Separate thick clothes & towels

    Keep them apart from everyday wear.

  3. Tip 3

    Don't leave wet clothes sitting

    That's how the musty smell sets in.

  4. Tip 4

    Schedule your laundry ahead

    Plan around the forecast.

  5. Tip 5

    Use free pick-up & delivery

    Stay dry. We'll come to you.
